tickets.title: EEG subset alignment, QC and classical decoding
tickets.notes: 19 subjects, docs/ds002158-eeg.md. Stage 1 (sub-02, sub-04) exploratory; stage 2 pre-registered (configs/ds002158_eeg_decoding_confirmatory.yaml) on 17 new subjects: 109/111 runs paired by timing; gradient + BCG template subtraction in all; positive control 17/17. Confidence after own decisions, post-decision window: within r = 0.16 (Holm p = 0.0009), leave-one-subject-out r = 0.10 (Holm p = 0.005); not pre-decision; mostly shared with accuracy/RT/evidence (residual r = 0.08 within, ~0 across). Follow-ups (post hoc): within-subject effect robust to OBS BCG removal (r = 0.12, Holm 0.028); cross-subject transfer is not (r = 0.04, Holm 0.36); ECG-only control does not carry the post-decision signal. Exploratory time course: ~0.2-0.6 s after the response, nothing before. Cardiac controls (2026-11-20): heartbeat timing unrelated to confidence (r ~ 0); confidence beyond heartbeat timing r = 0.16 within (Holm 0.005); ICA after AAS finds no heartbeat-locked component; ICA alone inadequate. Planted-signal test: OBS (4 PCs) keeps 54% of a slow response-locked signal, template subtraction 96%; OBS with 1 PC (less heartbeat residual than AAS) restores leave-one-subject-out r = 0.11 (Holm 0.006), as predicted. Own vs observed (plan committed first): own-trained decoder does not read observed confidence (r = -0.04) nor the reverse.

tickets.title: Belief updating RL benchmark
tickets.deliverable: model comparison, parameter recovery and predictive checking
tickets.notes: Behavior only. docs/ds007474-two-step-model.md. Design semantics verified. Hybrid > MF, MB on held-out runs, subjects and a separate session; follow-up: hybrid + win-stay/lose-shift best (also out of session), no false positives in recovery; separate learning rates not identifiable; no reliable contingency effect on w (both sessions). Possible next: learned pad transitions, trial-wise arbitration (isPost_*), hierarchical fitting. Follow-up 2 (2026-11-23, plan committed before fitting): trial-wise arbitration; MB weight lower after high-stakes trials (-0.27 [-0.44, -0.10], bootstrap-calibrated Holm p = 0.02; structural session -0.25); no state-uncertainty effect; no out-of-sample gain; magnitude-sensitive MF not excluded. Follow-up 3 (2026-11-24, plan committed first): with points-based model-free learning arb_high = +0.56 (calibrated Holm p = 0.04; structural +0.49), opposite sign; the stakes effect is not separable from magnitude sensitivity of learning; no arbitration claim. Follow-up 4 (2026-11-24, plan committed first): empirical-Bayes fitting recovers parameters better and predicts the structural session better than the fixed prior (hybrid_wsls +97 [56, 141]; arbitration model +223 [151, 301]); ranking unchanged.
